1.text: “Umuntu wabyawe n'umugore,Arama igihe gito kandi cyuzuyemo umuruho agakenyuka.

2.text: Avuka ameze nk'ururabyo, maze agacibwa,Ahita nk'igicucu kandi ntarame.

3.text: Mbese nawe umuntu umeze atyo warushya umureba,Cyangwa nkanjye wanshyira mu rubanza?

4.text: Ni nde wabasha kuvana igitunganye mu kintu cyanduye?Nta we.

5.text: Ubwo iminsi ye yategetswe,umubare w'amezi ye ugategekwa nawe,Kandi ukamushyiriraho urugabano atabasha kurenga,

6.text: Umukureho amaso abone akaruhuko,Kugeza ubwo azarangiza iminsi ye nk'ukorera ibihembo.

7.text: “Erega hariho ibyiringiro yuko igiti iyo gitemwe cyongera gushibuka,Kandi kikajya kigira amashami y'ibitontome.

8.text: Nubwo umuzi wacyo usazira mu butaka,N'igishyitsi cyacyo kigahera mu mukungugu,

9.text: Iyo cyumvise amazi cyongera gushibuka,Kigatoha nk'igiti kikiri gito.

10.text: Ariko umuntu we arapfa akagendanirako,Ni ukuri umwuka w'umuntu urahera.Ubwo akaba ari he?

11.text: “Uko amazi yo mu nyanja yuzuruka,N'umugezi uko ugabanuka ugakama;

12.text: Ni ko umuntu aryama ubutabyuka,Kugeza ubwo ijuru rizaba ritakiriho,ntabwo bazakanguka cyangwa kubyutswa ngo bave mu bitotsi byabo.

13.text: “Icyampa ukampisha ikuzimu,Ukandindira mu rwihisho kugeza ubwo uburakari bwawe buzashira,Ukantegekera igihe kandi ukazanyibuka.

14.text: Umuntu napfa azongera abeho?Naba nihanganiye iminsi y'intambara yanjye yose,Ntegereje igihe cyanjye cyo kurekurwa.

15.text: Wampamagara nakwitaba,Washatse kubona umurimo w'amaboko yawe.

16.text: Ariko ubu urabara intambwe zanjye,Mbese ntiwitegereza icyaha cyanjye?

17.text: Igicumuro cyanjye gikingiraniwe mu ruhago,N'ibyaha byanjye ubihambiriye hamwe.

18.text: Ariko umusozi utenguka uhinduka ubusa,Kandi urutare ruvanwa aho rwari ruri.

19.text: Amazi agimbya amabuye,Isuri itembana umukungugu wo ku isi,Uko ni ko ukuraho ibyo umuntu yizeye.

20.text: Umutsinda buheriheri akagendenirako,Uhindura mu maso he ukundi ukamwohēra.

21.text: Abahungu be bagira ikuzo ntabimenye,Bacishwa bugufi ntamenye agakuru kabo.

22.text: Ahubwo umubiri we ugira uburibwe,Kandi umutima wo muri we uramugongesha.”
